cohort: The study involved 269 babies born in several health centers in Gowa district, Indonesia.
finding: Maternal height and gestational age were significantly correlated with the child's body length at birth, while maternal weight, parity, and maternal age were not.
cross-section timing: Baby body length measurement was performed a maximum of 72 hours after birth.
gest_age: Gestational age was measured and found to be correlated with baby body length at birth.
